name: b5-threert-spike
description: ThreeRT M0 spike for babylon5-gardens (never published). The threert CLI bundles @threert/* from the SDK inside the pinned client (tsconfig paths). Do NOT npm-install @threert/* here or in any parent dir: esbuild then resolves node_modules first and the npm 0.1.1 build is older than the client SDK (no hud/host/input/audio; SkyAtmosphere -> 'unsupported environment').
